coder_notes: 5-ALA (PD L 506) iPDT: candidate with device_dependent true (laser activation). Registered arm contains only 5-ALA/iPDT; inclusion mentions eligibility for RT+TMZ but the record does not state that all patients receive TMZ within the study, so TMZ not listed and regimen coded monotherapy (adjudicator may consider subsequent Stupp as combination). tumour_pk_planned coded yes because interstitial fluorescence (PpIX derived from the candidate) is measured in tumour; this is borderline (could be considered a technical/device measurement). IDH wild-type requirement plus WHO 2016 citation -> cns5 per tie-break. Blood immune parameters (CD4/CD8) not recorded as tumour biomarkers.
